description: This pie chart, titled “Distribution of Reference Answer and Test Case,” visually represents the proportional breakdown of three categories within a dataset labeled “w/o Reference Answer and Test Case.” The chart is divided into three distinct slices: a large pink segment labeled “Null (549,238),” a large blue segment labeled “Have reference answer (38.9%),” and a smaller green segment labeled “Have test case (21.9%).” The chart includes a legend in the top-left corner that maps the colors to their respective categories and counts, and percentage labels are explicitly displayed within or adjacent to each slice. The slices appear to be arranged in descending order of size, with the pink “Null” segment being the largest, followed by the blue “Have reference answer” segment, and then the green “Have test case” segment.
